diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions that produce no new outcome. `result:repeated` has 1,485 positive operations versus 224 negative operations, a net candidate excess of 1,261 across 88 candidate-excess sessions versus 20 base-excess sessions. Repeated clicks, noops, and scrolls contribute most of the excess.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged outcomes and forcing reassessment should reduce loops and conserve interaction budget, improving the chance of productive progress. Costs are lightweight state tracking and occasional premature strategy changes when an additional retry would have succeeded.
policy_text: Track the outcome signature of each action. If the same or equivalent action produces no new state twice, stop repeating it: reassess the objective, change strategy or target, and only retry when new evidence predicts a different result. Cap unchanged retries and record the reason for any override.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith("result:")))]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '$2=="result:repeated" {if($1>0)p+=$1; else n+=-$1} END {print p,n,p-n}'
quantitative_evidence.finding: Outputs `1485 224 1261`: candidate/bad excess contains 1,485 repeated-result operations, base/good excess contains 224, for a net candidate excess of 1,261.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith("result:"))), .labels.source_session[0]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '$2=="result:repeated" {if($1>0)p[$3]=1; else n[$3]=1} END {for(x in p)pc++; for(x in n)nc++; print pc,nc}'
quantitative_evidence.finding: Outputs `88 20`: repeated-result positive excess occurs across 88 candidate-side source sessions, compared with negative excess across 20 base-side sessions.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith("result:"))), (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith("action:")))]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '$2=="result:repeated" {if($1>0)p[$3]+=$1; else n[$3]+=-$1} END {for(a in p)print a,p[a],n[a]+0,p[a]-n[a]}' | sort -k4,4nr | head -3
quantitative_evidence.finding: The three largest contributors are `action:click 679 40 639`, `action:noop 441 85 356`, and `action:scroll 278 1 277` (candidate count, base count, signed excess).
